notes: High-signal mid-market SaaS (customer engagement + agent assist). Product: omnichannel support + AI summarization. Currently prototype on OpenAI; evaluating Redwood first via Hosted API POC, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit costs. -- Discovery call 2025-01-22: AE Marcus, SE Priya, VPEng A. Ortiz. Customer quote: 'we need predictable pricing and regional isolation for EU clients'. -- Demo 2025-01-29: Hosted API chat demo (small sandbox). Customer measured baseline: p95 latency ~210ms for simple chat flows; throughput tested ~35 concurrent agents before queueing. Embedding pipeline: 1k docs/min requirement for nightly indexing. -- POC objectives: 1) match latency SLO (p95 <250ms for chat), 2) reduce token unit cost vs Hosted baseline, 3) support EU residency for subset of data, 4) evaluate autoscaling/burst behaviour. -- Cost-optimization workshop 2025-02-10 (SE-led): focused on batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization profiles. Outputs: recommended batching window 8-12ms for user-facing chat to hit 25-30% lower per-token cost without noticeable latency impact; enable prefix KV cache on support dialogs -> expected 20% token savings on repeat flows; quantization profile (8-bit + per-layer calibration) for their chosen LLM candidate projected to reduce GPU memory footprint and MRRP by ~35% on Dedicated. Unit economics: modeled at 3 production routes (hosted fallback, dedicated steady state, dedicated burst) -> projected ARR impact: move to Dedicated + caching + quantization = ~45% reduction in variable inference spend vs Hosted-only at target volume (estimated). -- Security: insists on SSO, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for keys, audit trail for PII. Legal asked for DPA + residency SLA. -- Pricing: initial Dedicated pricing request to finance (asked for 12-month committed tier + burst credits). Customer cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit for predictable unit economics but needs clear math for break-even vs Hosted. -- Internal notes: product team cares about degradation policies; platform team wants canary and automatic fallback to hosted. They prefer Redwood Optimize for ongoing suggestions. -- Next: Priya to deliver quantitative POC report (latency curves, cost models, quantization verification) by 2025-02-17. Follow-up meeting booked 2025-02-24 to review Dedicated demo and final pricing options.

poc_results_summary: Hosted baseline: reasonable latency but cost high at scale. Workshop showed batching + KV caching reduces inference token volume by ~20-35% depending on chat repeatability. Quantization experiments (8-bit) on candidate models reduced GPU footprint and per-inference cost by ~30-40% in lab. Recommendation: start Hosted for fast rollout, run hybrid Dedicated for customer EU-sensitive traffic + peak throughput; commit to 12-month Dedicated with burst credits after legal sign-off.
technical_requirements_summary: Targets: p95 latency <=250ms for chat, support 50 concurrent live agents with minimal queueing, nightly embeddings throughput 1000 docs/min, EU data residency for subset, KMS integration, audit logs retention 1 year. Need canary rollback, A/B model routing, and fallback to hosted without data bleed.

Also asked about penalty-free fallback and SLA credits. Estimated ARR range provided to customer as guidance; ask RevOps for official quote before 2025-02-24.
